title: Flexible neural population dynamics govern the speed and stability of sensory encoding in mouse visual cortex
goal: Reproduce and exceed the source-reported empirical method endpoint on identical original observations and evaluation support. Original Figures 2h and 4d,e six-speed V1 decoder performance on all five primary mice, both stationary and locomotion states, complete within-time curves and cross-time accuracy matrices, with source relative-generalization profiles and their raw numerator/denominator. This version selects empirical decoder performance; it does not define biological superiority as a larger locomotion effect. The prior paired mouse-level state/time biological interpretation and indispensable original biological contrasts remain first-class separately scoped reproduction under the unchanged root reproduction.v1.json and archived prior task. Method improvement neither verifies nor invalidates that broader interpretation automatically.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: complete executable source-method outputs and native reference-equivalence evidence under primary-endpoint-v1/reproduction.v2.json.
Improvement: same original full-panel method performance against the strongest relevant author baseline under primary-endpoint-v1/improvement.v1.json; no scalar shortcut or current-SOTA claim.
Separate paired paper+data and paper+data+official-code records with identical common input, scientific support and cumulative budgets.
Retained broader biological reproduction remains independently named in primary-endpoint-v1/selection.v1.json.
success_criteria: Recreate the selected original method endpoint and all declared source companions using authentic source observations and independently verified submitted computation.

Exceed the strongest relevant authenticated author comparator only after meaningful native-unit full-panel superiority and mouse-level uncertainty rules are frozen; preserving original task inputs/splits/metric is mandatory.
Keep reproduction and improvement independent, with all four outcome/assistance cells unknown until qualified execution.
Retain complete original cohort and condition support; paper observations, metadata, local fixed controls and author replay do not establish AI success.
Preserve broader biological reproduction separately; method gains do not imply a larger biological effect or current SOTA.

Directional improvement concerns true-label within-time and cross-time accuracy on the original full source support only. Relative-generalization ratios, their numerator/denominator, source biological contrasts and any shuffle/null outputs are fidelity/protection companions, never targets rewarded merely for increasing. Ratios cannot improve by degrading their diagonal denominator.
